description:
Completely Uninstall Unwanted Software, Windows Apps & Browser Plug-ins

IObit Uninstaller is a powerful tool designed to thoroughly remove unwanted programs, browser plug-ins, and Windows apps. It ensures a clean and smooth PC by detecting and uninstalling stubborn software and associated files. With features like batch uninstallation, software health management, and browser protection, IObit Uninstaller enhances system performance and security.
v16.0 (2026-09-09)
- New Software Relocator in Toolbox: Move installed software to other drives without reinstallation, freeing up space on critical drives.
- New Bloatware Remover in Toolbox: Uninstall pre‑installed Windows apps and system components to achieve a leaner, faster‑running PC.
- Improved Software Health: Deeper residual file cleaning and more precise analysis of software impact on system performance. 
- Improved Powerscan: Boosted uninstall cleanup capability, enabling more thorough removal of leftover files.
- Completely redesigned UI featuring a cleaner layout and more intuitive navigation.
- Refined Dark and Light modes for a smoother and more user‑friendly experience.
- Added support for 39 languages
